## Summary

Research confidence is **Moderate**. Some of this break's ideal conditions are confirmed by sources; others rest on limited evidence. It is the class the app computes from the evidence (how well the break's ideal conditions are documented), not a forecast and not a probability.

Main gaps:

- This break has no listed tide preference to compare the sources with.
- Limited information is available about the swell period this break needs.
- No survey, scientific or official source confirms the best swell direction.
- No survey, scientific or official source confirms the best wind direction.

Research notes (research_evidence.json):

> All 6 sources were read directly (5 publishers: Surf-Forecast, WannaSurf, The Inertia, Sol Bungalows, Club Venao). None is encyclopedia, official or peer-reviewed. No Wikipedia article covers the break; the Bastimentos Island article only mentions the island's August-March wave season. Crossref was not searched (no plausible break study). Swell direction: Surf-Forecast NE, WannaSurf N-NE and Club Venao NE all sit inside the 350-40 optimum. Wind: Surf-Forecast says SW is best and offshore; WannaSurf lists SW/S as good wind. Both are within 35 deg of 190. Club Venao's 'Wind: SW' does not say offshore or best, so it has no value. Turko (The Inertia) says offshores funnel down the channel between the islands and chop up the face, which is a local wind effect. Size: WannaSurf says it works from 5-6 ft and holds 16 ft and over; Club Venao says it 'can hold over 20ft'. That phrasing mirrors Magicseaweed's description (quoted on a 2017 blog), so it may not be independent. A WannaSurf contributor says it only breaks once Dumpers is over 8 ft. Period: nothing numeric; Surf-Forecast says windswell is more common than groundswell. The 9/12 s profile values are unsupported. Tide: Surf-Forecast, WannaSurf and Club Venao all say all tides. The profile's null could become 'all'. Season: Turko gives Nov-Apr and Sol Bungalows Dec-Apr, both for Bocas generally. Club Venao gives Jan, Feb and July, but the same line appears for every Bocas spot on its page (templated). Surf-Forecast's March/spring line is only in the raw HTML widget and was dropped. July is outside the profile's Dec-Mar; Sol Bungalows also calls June-August a secondary 'mini season' for Bocas. Bathymetry: coral reef and sharp rock, breaking in deep water over a cavernous reef (WannaSurf). Sol Bungalows calls it a deep-water slab. No measured bathymetry exists. Turko also says the swell faded 'once the tide started sucking out'. This was not recorded as a tide preference because it describes one session.

## Ideal conditions

Directions are compass degrees the swell or wind comes FROM, ranges clockwise. Heights keep the scale each source states (breaking face, Hawaiian, swell or relative to the surfer); the app's sizes are breaking face heights in feet. Sources are numbered as in [Sources](#sources).

### Swell height

| Field | Research value | Status | Sources | App model setting |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum suitable | 5–6 ft | documented | S2, S6 | `wave_height_min_ft` 6 ft (breaking face) |
| Ideal range | — | not documented | — | no separate setting; working range 6–20 ft |
| Maximum suitable | 16–20 ft | documented | S2, S6 | `wave_height_max_ft` 20 ft (breaking face) |

Notes:

- **Minimum suitable**: WannaSurf says it starts working at 1.5-2 m / 5-6 ft (the page's own conversion, scale not stated) and a WannaSurf contributor says it only breaks once the nearby Dumpers passes 8 ft; Club Venao says it needs a big swell.
  - S2 (WannaSurf): “Starts working at 1.5m-2m /5ft-6ft and holds up to 5m / 16 ft and over”
  - S2 (WannaSurf): “It only breaks when Dumpers passes 8ft.”
  - S6 (Club Venao (surfing-panama.com)): “It needs a big swell and can hold over 20ft swell.”
- **Ideal range**: No excerpt states an ideal or best size range.
- **Maximum suitable**: WannaSurf says it holds up to 5 m / 16 ft and over and Club Venao says it can hold over 20 ft swell; both are open-ended ('and over'), so they do not contradict each other, and Club Venao's wording ('swell') may mean swell rather than face height (the evidence notes add that its phrasing mirrors Magicseaweed, so it may not be independent).
  - S2 (WannaSurf): “Starts working at 1.5m-2m /5ft-6ft and holds up to 5m / 16 ft and over”
  - S6 (Club Venao (surfing-panama.com)): “It needs a big swell and can hold over 20ft swell.”

## Conflicting information

- **Seasonality · prime months**: Turko (The Inertia) says Bocas is best from November to April and Sol Bungalows says December to April (both for Bocas generally), while Club Venao lists January, February and July (the same line for every Bocas spot); the first two agree on December to April, and July is the disagreement.
